name: Fathom
description: Binary Ninja and the Fathom debugger side by side: follow the debuggee, breakpoints, run to here, traces.
longdescription: Connects to Fathom (an x64dbg-based debugger) through its pybridge plugin: the view follows the debuggee's instruction pointer, addresses are shown in the debugger, breakpoints and run-to-here are set from Binary Ninja, and traces exported by Fathom are highlighted. In Fathom: pybridge.start.

installinstructions.Windows: Copy the fathom_binja folder into %APPDATA%\Binary Ninja\plugins (with x64dbg_bridge.py from Fathom's pybridge\python, already there in a Fathom release).

author: EGKrb
